SR-51
STEERING POWER STEERING GEAH
INSTALLATION
1. INSTALL ENGINE REAR MOUNT INSULATOR AND
ENGINE REAR MOUNT BRACKET
{a) Install the engine rear mount bracket with the 3 bolts.
Torque: 64 N-m (655 kgf-cm, 47 ft-lbf)
(b) Install the engine rear mount insulator with the through
boll.
Torque: 87 N-m (890 kgf.cm, 64 ft,lbf)
2. INSTALL PS GEAR ASSEMBLY
(a) Align the malchmarks on the intermediate extension and
control valve shaft.
(b} Install the bolt.
Torque: 35 N•m (360 kgf-cm, 26 ft-lbf)
(c} Install the PS gear assembly with the 4 bolts to the front
suspension member.
Torque: 58 N-m (591 kgf.cm, 43 ft-lbf)
N
3. INSTALL FRONT SUSPENSION MEMBER WITH LOW­
ER SUSPENSION ARM AND PS GEAR ASSEMBLY
E Install the front suspension member with lower suspension arm
and PS gear assembly with the 6 bolts (bolt C, D and E}.
Torque:
Bolt C: 157 N-m (1,600 kgf-cm, 116 ft.Jbf)
Bolt D: 157 N-m (1,600 kgf.cm, 116 ft-lbf)
Bolt E: 39 N-m (400 kgf.cm, 29 ft-lbf)
4. CONNECT ENGINE FRONT MOUNT INSULATOR AND
FRONT SUSPENSION MEMBER
Connect the engine front mount insulator and front suspension
member with the 2 bolts (bolt B).
Torque: 52 N.m (530 kgf.cm, 38 ft.lbf)
5. CONNECT ENGINE REAR MOUNT INSULATOR AND
FRONT SUSPENSION MEMBER
Connect the engine rear mount insulator and front suspension
member with the bolt (bolt A) and 3 nuts.
Torque: 52 N-m (530 kgf .cm, 38 ft.I bf)
N 6. CONNECT STABILIZER BAR
(a) Connect the stabilizer bar with the nut.
Torque: 44 N.m (449 kgf.cm, 32 tt-lbt)
{b) Employ the same manner described above to the other
side.
7. CONNECT LOWER BALL JOINT TO LOWER SUSPEN-
SION ARM (See page SA-45)
